title: Monotonicity of safe segments
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F,F'$ be sets of states, and $P,P'$ be predicates on work-tape head positions. If a run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ before time $t$, satisfies $P$ throughout times $0$ through $t$, and $b$'s state avoids $F$, then, whenever $F'\subseteq F$ and $P(p)\Rightarrow P'(p)$ for every head-position vector $p$, the same run is a safe segment relative to $F'$ and $P'$.
hypotheses_covered: A safe segment relative to $F$ and $P$
For every work-tape head-position vector $p$, $P(p)$ implies $P'(p)$
